steps.name: Set attraction hours
steps.do: Open **Set attraction hours**. Choose **Conservation Carousel**. Set weekday and weekend/holiday start/end within zoo hours.

steps.name: Submit hours
steps.expect: Success “Conservation Carousel attraction hours were saved.”

steps.name: Itinerary outside hours
steps.do: On **Itinerary** for a day those hours apply, schedule **Conservation Carousel** outside its open window.
steps.expect: **Outside Attraction Hours** appears; choosing **Adjust** moves the time into the attraction’s hours.

steps.name: Closure override
steps.do: Open **Create attraction closure override**. Choose **Conservation Carousel**, leave dates blank or covering today, and enter a **Closure message** (e.g. **Manual test attraction closed**).
steps.expect: Success that the **Conservation Carousel** closure override was saved.

steps.name: Map closed
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Map**. On **Specific Map**, set the date to today. In **Filter:**, enable **Attractions**. Leave **Include closed attractions** unchecked, then check it and click the **Conservation Carousel** marker.
steps.expect: With include off, the marker is absent. With include on, the marker appears; tooltip/banner shows the **Closure message**.

steps.name: Itinerary closed confirm
steps.do: Use **Edit Itinerary**. On **Add Attractions**, enable **Include closed attractions**, and add **Conservation Carousel**.
steps.expect: **The Conservation Carousel is closed on your visit date. Do you still want to add it to your itinerary?**

steps.name: Hours still valid
steps.do: On Day Planner, open **Schedule item**, choose **Attraction**, search **Conservation Carousel**, and schedule it outside its hours.
